config.wyverncolors.potentialFontSize.de: Mount potential text size: 50–125%%. Default: 70%%. Long labels shrink to fit. Shared with Wynntils.
config.wyverncolors.potentialAtBottom.de: Place mount potential at the bottom of the item sprite instead of the top. Shared with Wyvern Colors in Mod Menu.
config.wyverncolors.potentialPosition.de: Choose an edge or corner for mount potential text. Default: Top Left. Shared with Wynntils.
config.wyverncolors.potentialOverride.de: Use these size and position settings for mount potential. Turn off to use Wynntils’ placement and size.
screen.wyverncolors.potential.title: Wyvern Colors
screen.wyverncolors.potential.shared: Size/position use Wynntils; opacity uses Wyvern Colors.
screen.wyverncolors.potential.otherStat: Select Potential in Wynntils to change its text.
config.wyverncolors.swapColors.descripti: On: horn-colored swirl and scale-colored trim. Off: scale-colored swirl and horn-colored trim. Applies to reins only.
config.wyverncolors.debugLogging.descrip: Write up to 64 mount snapshots to latest.log for troubleshooting. Off by default. Takes effect immediately.
screen.wyverncolors.saveFailed: Could not save settings. See latest.log.
screen.wyverncolors.legacy.text: Potential text uses your Wynntils settings.
message.wyverncolors.colorFallback: [Wyvern Colors] %s Using Wynncraft's original icons for affected items. Supported colors remain enabled. Details: latest.log.

message.wyverncolors.reason.appearance: Some mount appearances are missing, unknown, or conflicting.
message.wyverncolors.reason.model-assets: Some custom mount icons could not be loaded.
message.wyverncolors.reason.item-data: Some mount color data could not be read.
message.wyverncolors.reason.render: A custom mount icon failed to render.
config.wyverncolors.potentialOpacity.des: Potential text and outline opacity: 0–100%%. Zero hides the label. Default: 100%%. Saved by Wyvern Colors; works with customization on or off.
